text: Aurora flagging softer orders in one region - incremental demand headwind. Cautious near-term, watching for broader slowdown.
Aurora flagged slightly softer orders in one region. Price has drifted down for 5 straight epochs with no bounce yet. Staying cautious until we see stabilization.
Aurora flagging softer orders in one region plus steady drift down looks mildly bearish near-term.
Aurora softer orders + steady downtrend - cautious bearish near term
Softer regional orders, drift lower - mildly cautious on Aurora here.
Aurora softer orders in one region and steady drift lower. Cautious near-term on A.
Aurora softer orders + 5 epochs drifting down. Cautious/bearish near term.
Aurora softer orders in one region + steady downtrend. Cautious here, short bias.
Aurora: 6 epochs down, margin concerns + soft orders. Trend intact, staying short until stabilization shows.
Aurora margin trim + 6 epochs downtrend outweighs single contract renewal - cautious bearish, short bias near term.
Aurora still drifting lower, mixed news not enough to reverse trend. Staying bearish short bias for now.
Mixed for Aurora: margin worries weigh vs mid-sized renewal offset. Net trend still soft, cautious/bearish until momentum stabilizes.

Aurora still in six-epoch downtrend with analyst margin trim outweighing mid-sized contract renewal. Price bounced intra-epoch but closed lower again. Staying short biased until we see a sustained reversal.
Analyst margin trim hit first, then contract renewal sparked a sharp intraday bounce. Downtrend is still intact over 6 epochs but the squeeze cost us; trimming short exposure until trend confirms.
Aurora margin worries + steady 6-epoch slide outweighs renewal. Staying bearish on A.
Aurora renewal de-risks near-term, dip already recovering - turning constructive on A.
Margin pressure + steady downtrend outweighs one renewal. Bearish tilt on A near-term.
Aurora margin worries + steady downtrend outweigh mid-sized renewal. Staying cautious, short bias.
Margin worries + steady downtrend outweigh routine renewal. Short bias on Aurora.
Aurora 6 epochs down looks oversold, renewal + late bounce stabilizing. Turning constructive/bullish near term.
Aurora forced liquidation selloff is temporary flow not fundamentals. -176bps drop looks overdone and ripe for sharp mean-reversion bounce. Turning strongly bullish on A near-term.

Aurora forced liquidation headlines + 6-epoch downtrend points to continued overhang. Seller flow likely to persist near-term, downside momentum intact - staying bearish/short for now, risk of further washout.
Forced seller flush in A looks capitulatory - price already down 6 epochs and -176bps last. Liquidations are temporary supply, expecting sharp rebound once cleared. Flipping long.
Forced liquidation of a large A holder adds fresh supply overhang on top of a 6-epoch downtrend with margin/soft order concerns. Downside pressure likely persists into next epoch.
Aurora forced fund liquidation explains sharp drop, pressure may linger briefly but move looks stretched after 7 epochs down. Trimming short risk, still cautious bearish until stabilization confirms.

Forced liquidation of a large fund’s A holdings adds fresh supply to an already weakening tape. Price remains well below the prior epoch high ~9890 and the six-epoch downtrend is intact. Staying short-biased near term.
Forced fund liquidation in A = heavy overhang. Downtrend + fire sale, staying short, expect lower.
Forced fund liquidation flushing Aurora looks capitulation - temporary pressure, bounce setup. Turning bullish long here.
Aurora liquidation-driven flush looks overdone and already bouncing. Buying this washout for reversal.
Large fund forced liquidation overhang on Aurora + breakdown to new lows. Expect continued pressure near-term, staying short bias.
Aurora selloff driven by fund liquidation, not business. Temporary supply, deeply oversold - buying dip for snapback.
Forced liquidation washout after 6 downs looks overdone, 9590 low already bouncing to 9695. Covering shorts, turning bullish on A for snap-back.

Aurora losing biggest customer changes story - not a temporary liquidation bounce anymore. Fundamental revenue hit + 7-epoch downtrend intact, the snap-back to 9870 already rejected to 9725. Expect trapped longs to unwind and pressure back toward lows.

Aurora liquidation flush cleared - bounce from 9656 to 9828+ shows strength, +105bps momentum building. Customer headlines look overdone vs technical recovery, dip already bought. Staying bullish, expecting continuation higher near-term.
Aurora just lost its biggest customer on top of forced liquidation overhang. Fundamental hit + failed bounce under 9890, downside momentum intact
A bounce on liquidation is overdone - new loss of biggest customer at t3805 changes fundamentals. Crowded bounce longs at risk, staying short.
Aurora lost biggest customer - fundamental hit dwarfs prior liquidation noise. Bounce looks done, downside pressure ahead.

Aurora just lost its biggest customer. That's a fundamental hit on top of the liquidation overhang. The recent short-covering bounce looks tired and the bounce into negative news is unsettling. Staying net short but trimming a bit into this risk; downside risk reasserts if the market digests the customer loss.
Aurora lost its biggest customer - bounce was short-covering, fundamentals broken. Staying short, expect leg lower.
Aurora losing biggest customer is huge fundamental blow, bounce looks overdone. Short A expecting selloff.
Aurora loses biggest customer = major fundamental hit. Downtrend + new overhang, staying max short, expect lower as market absorbs.
Aurora losing biggest customer kills bounce thesis. Topped 9814 fading to 9757, crowded longs trapped. Short A heavily.
Aurora reportedly losing biggest customer into this bounce looks serious. Fading the +105bps snap-back, turning bearish short on A.
Aurora losing biggest customer is fundamental, not flow. Bounce trapped longs, fading into close. Short here.
Aurora flush looks overdone - double renewal wins + analyst lift vs one-time customer loss. Crowded shorts trapped after -315bps, bounce setting up. Going long A for squeeze.
A contract renewals x2 contradict customer loss rumor - rumor looks unconfirmed vs official newswire. Crowded short after -315bps is ripe for squeeze. Stepping aside / neutral here.

Aurora still structurally weak after losing biggest customer - that renewal is mid-sized only, doesn't replace lost revenue. Trend is down 7 of 8 epochs and -315bps last, bounce to 9444 already fading. Staying max short, downside not done.
Aurora flush -315bps now capitulated on customer loss - renewal wins x2 + analyst support into crowded short should squeeze. Flipping long for bounce.

Renewal of mid-sized supply contract and analyst tweak is noise vs the biggest-customer loss and the technical breakdown. Price broke 97.3k and closed latest epoch near 94.4k with down-trend intact; short covering bounce is exhausted. Expect continuation lower as market digests fundamentals.
Biggest customer loss outweighs small renewals/analyst nudge. Downtrend intact, staying short A.
Aurora mid-size renewal can't offset biggest-customer loss. -315bps dump on good news = weak hands holding. Staying short, lower ahead.
Capitulation flush to 9263 cleared, renewal + analyst support, bounce to 9444 starting. Crowded shorts trapped, going long squeeze.
Aurora washed out -315bps on stale customer fears, double renewal + analyst lift, 9263 low held to 9444. Oversold bounce setup, going long.
Renewal of mid-sized contract doesn't offset losing biggest customer. Downtrend + failed bounce, staying short A.
Aurora double renewal + analyst lift stabilizing after overdone selloff. Off lows 9263->9444, bounce building. Long A here.
Aurora renewal x2 confirms customer-loss fear overdone. +156bps bounce off capitulation low holds despite intraday fade. Crowded shorts still trapped - long squeeze continuation.
No new news after double renewal bounce; intraday fade 9773->9616 suggests bounce pausing. Staying cautious long but not chasing, execution costs on flips huge.

Bounce to 97.7k rejected and price rolling back under 96.5k after failed reclaim of breakdown zone. Customer-loss overhang still dominates fundamentals and downtrend intact. Trimming short to manage risk after the squeeze move, staying bearish.

Aurora double renewal + analyst support confirms capitulation bottom at 9462 - bounce to 9773 shows demand. Crowded shorts still trapped after -315bps flush, expecting continuation higher. Staying long A, squeeze not done.

Aurora double renewal wins + analyst support confirm bottom at 9263, +155 bounce building momentum off oversold flush. Crowded shorts trapped after -315, higher lows forming, squeeze setup intact. Going long A - upside ahead!
Bounce to 9773 faded to 9616, 50% retrace done. Customer loss > mid-size renewal, staying short A.
Bounce to 9773 rejected and fading, lower highs intact. Staying short A, downside resuming.
Aurora bounce failed 9773->9609, biggest customer loss dwarfs renewals. Fading into close, short A.
A bounce to 9773 faded to 9616, squeeze exhausted. Biggest-customer loss dwarfs mid-size renewal, staying short A.
Aurora bounce to 9773 faded to 9616, customer loss outweighs small renewals. Short A, downtrend resuming.
Aurora +155bps bounce already failing 9773->9616, fading into close. Customer loss > renewals, shorts reloading. Short A, lower ahead.
Grind higher intact despite soft order nibble - double analyst lifts support. Staying long into close.
Aurora bounce holding higher low 9579 -> 9636, analyst support + renewal overpowers soft orders noise. Trend up into close, long.

Softer orders flagged in one region today outweighs the analyst re-rate. Price is grinding up to 9,635 but still well under 9.89k resistance and downtrend intact after the failed 9.77k reclaim. Customer loss overhang dominates, staying short A.

Aurora softer orders confirms demand weakness on top of biggest customer loss - renewal/analyst nudge is noise. Bounce faded 9773->9635, +28bps stall on low vol, lower highs intact. Short A, downside resuming.
Aurora softer orders confirms customer-loss overhang, analyst tweak is noise after 9773 rejection faded to 9635. Mid-size renewals don't offset biggest customer. Short A, breakdown resuming.
Aurora double analyst pump duplicated, only +28bps, running out of steam. Softer orders + biggest customer loss > renewals. Short A, fade the grind.
Aurora double analyst nudge is noise, softer orders + biggest-customer loss dominate. Bounce slowing into resistance 9636, fading. Short A.
Soft orders confirm weakness, analyst nudge is noise. 9773 rejection holds, staying short A.
Aurora bounce stalling 9773->9636 lower high, softer orders confirms weakness. Analyst tweak noise vs customer loss. Short A.
Aurora softer orders + biggest-customer loss dwarfs analyst tweak. Failed 9773 fade holding, short A downside resuming.
Softer orders confirms demand fade, rally under 9773 lower high fading. Analyst pump vs customer loss, short A.
